## Findings

### 1) Lewis & Clark — San Diego admissions representative
Lewis & Clark’s California county-assignment page lists **Qwadere Lovell** for **San Diego County**. I did not find a direct Lovell email or telephone number published on that assignment page. The College’s published Admissions contact details are **admissions@lclark.edu** and **503-768-7040** (fax: 503-768-7055).

- [Lewis & Clark: California admissions assignments](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/)

### 2) Hunter College Silberman — Fall 2026 MSW deadline
For the fall-entry MSW programs (Two-Year Full-Time, Dual Degree–Bank Street, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency), the **application deadline is March 1** and the **supporting-document deadline is March 15**.

- [Silberman School of Social Work: Deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

### 3) Indiana University Kokomo — graduate programs
IU Kokomo’s graduate-programs page says its offerings span master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate study. Its current graduate-degree offerings include:

- **Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
- **Master of Science in Management**
- **Master of Science in Strategic Finance**
- **Master of Public Management**
- **Master of Arts in Mental Health Counseling**
- **Master of Science in Nursing (MSN)** — with Nursing Education, Leadership & Systems Innovation, and Family Nurse Practitioner tracks
- **Master of Science in Education in Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum**
- **M.S.Ed. in the Science of Reading**
- Online graduate degrees including **MA in English**, **MA in History**, **Master of Liberal Studies**, and **MS in Criminal Justice and Public Safety**.

The School of Business also explicitly lists the graduate certificates in **Leadership** and **Business Analytics**, plus postbaccalaureate certificates in **Accounting** and **Business Fundamentals**.

- [IU Kokomo: Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html)
- [IU Kokomo School of Business: Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/business/degrees/graduate-programs.html)
- [IU Kokomo MSN information](https://kokomo.iu.edu/nursing/)

### 4) Recruiting glioblastoma trials in Northern California
ClinicalTrials.gov is a U.S. government registry; recruitment and site availability can change, so prospective participants should use the study contacts to confirm eligibility and openings.

1. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **NCT06805305**
   - Status: **Recruiting**
   - Northern California site: **UCSF, San Francisco, CA 94143**
   - Listed site contact: Stephanie Lewis, 415-353-2193; NeuroOncNewPatientCoord@ucsf.edu
   - [ClinicalTrials.gov record](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06805305)

2. **B7-H3 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cells (B7-H3CART) in Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme** — **NCT05474378**
   - Status: **Recruiting**
   - Northern California site: **Stanford Cancer Institute, Palo Alto, CA 94305**
   - Listed study/site contact: Kelly Tanner, 650-724-5361; ketanner@stanford.edu
   - [ClinicalTrials.gov record](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05474378)

### 5) Oral Roberts University — student activities leadership
ORU’s current public Student Life leadership page does **not** use a “Director of Student Activities” title. The Student Association material identifies **Augustine Mendoza** as **Director of Student Experience**; ORU’s current Vice President of Student Life directory lists him as **Director of Spiritual Life**. This appears to be the current closest match for the student-activities/student-experience leadership role.

- **Augustine Mendoza** — **augiemendoza@oru.edu**; **918-495-7727**.
- [ORU: Vice President of Student Life / leadership contacts](https://oru.edu/about-oru/administration/vice-president-student-life.php)

### 6) EDF Energy — graduate-programme salary-review wording
The official EDF Energy early-careers graduate/placement brochure uses the following exact wording:

> **“Starting salary is £35,000. You’ll receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowances and other flexible benefits.”**

Thus, the official wording is **“annual increases”**—not “salary reviews.” Current individual EDF graduate vacancies can set different starting salaries by role, so the quoted brochure language should not be treated as a guaranteed salary figure for every currently advertised programme.

- [EDF Energy, *Graduate and Placement Brochure 2023–2024* (official PDF)](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf)
- [EDF UK: current Graduate Careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers)

conversation.text:
I am preparing a brief for a graduate student in San Diego and would appreciate help locating a few current examples. Please find:

- The Lewis & Clark admissions representative assigned to San Diego, including the representative’s contact details.
- Hunter College Silberman’s Fall 2026 MSW application deadline.
- The graduate programs offered at Indiana University Kokomo.
- At least two actively recruiting glioblastoma clinical trials in Northern California, with locations and recruiting status.
- The current student activities director at Oral Roberts University, with official contact information if published.
- The official EDF Energy graduate programme information on salary reviews for new hires, including the exact wording used.

Please rely on the institutions’ or organizations’ own pages where possible and provide links for each item.

R1.reason: The open Lewis & Clark California assignment page supports that Qwadere Lovell covers San Diego County, but the answer supplies only general Admissions contact details rather than Lovell’s listed direct contact details.

R2.reason: The answer reports March 1 as the Fall 2026 MSW application deadline and the official Silberman Deadlines page is open.

R3.reason: The answer provides a substantive list of IU Kokomo graduate offerings and the official Graduate Programs page is left open for comparison.

R4.reason: The answer names two glioblastoma studies as Recruiting with San Francisco and Palo Alto locations, and separate ClinicalTrials.gov study tabs for NCT06805305 and NCT05474378 remain open.

R5.reason: The answer expressly says ORU does not identify a Director of Student Activities and substitutes Augustine Mendoza in other roles, without an open official ORU page establishing him as the requested student-activities director.

R6.reason: The answer quotes the official EDF brochure’s exact salary language, “You’ll receive annual increases,” and the cited official EDF PDF remains open.

R7.reason: The final response is a compact six-part summary covering every requested topic and includes a source link or source reference for each finding.

P1_asked_for.reason: The response supplies linked answers for all six requested topics, but it does not firmly identify a current ORU “student activities director,” instead offering a tentative closest-match role, and EDF evidence is an older 2023–24 brochure rather than clearly current programme information.

P2_readable_for_them.reason: The well-structured headings, concise lists, exact quotation, and source links suit this formal, detail-leaning research-capable user.

P3_actionable.reason: It provides direct official or primary-source links, contact details where found, deadlines, and trial contacts, though the ORU identification is uncertain and the EDF source may not establish a current new-hire policy.

P4_gap_handling.reason: It appropriately flags that trial recruitment can change and acknowledges the ORU title discrepancy, but it still presents Augustine Mendoza as the closest match without adequately verifying that he is the requested student-activities leader or resolving the conflict between titles.

P5_overall.reason: A skeptical professional preparing a brief would receive a useful, mostly source-backed summary, but would need to independently verify the ORU role and whether the EDF brochure remains current.

unmet_requests: “The current student activities director at Oral Roberts University, with official contact information if published.”
missed_gaps: Whether the role titled “student activities director” has been renamed at ORU and which current official page definitively establishes responsibility for student activities.
Whether the EDF 2023–2024 brochure’s “annual increases” language remains applicable to current graduate-programme hires.

P1_asked_for.reason: The response addressed all six requested topics with institution/organization links, but it did not conclusively identify an ORU official holding the specific “student activities director” role and instead offered a closest-match role.

P2_readable_for_them.reason: The structured headings, concise bullet points, quoted EDF wording, and clear caveats suit a formal, detail-leaning research user.

P3_actionable.reason: It provides direct source links, usable admissions and trial contact details, trial locations and statuses, and reports the relevant pages left open, though the ORU contact-role match and current applicability of the older EDF brochure remain uncertain.

P4_gap_handling.reason: The assistant appropriately flagged changing trial availability, the absence of a direct Lewis & Clark contact on the assignment page, the ORU title discrepancy, and the age of the EDF brochure, but it did not resolve those uncertainties before presenting conclusions.

P5_overall.reason: A skeptical, research-capable user would receive a well-organized and mostly sourceable outreach brief, with meaningful reservations about the ORU identification and whether the EDF quotation reflects current policy.

unmet_requests: “The current student activities director at Oral Roberts University, with official contact information if published.”
